routing.heading: Give your agent a fallback model.
routing.copy: List your preferred models in order. If the first is unavailable, Tangle Router calls the next. Its routing trace records every model and provider it tried.

run-story.heading: Benchmark coding agents on your own repo.
run-story.copy: Claude Code and Codex each tackled the same three bugs, using the same model and a fresh checkout for every attempt. Both passed all three checks.
